verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਜ ਮਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ਅਤਿ ਪੁਰਬ ਤੀਰਥ ਕੋਟਿ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: charan kamal raj majan prataap at purab teerath koT charan saran hai ||

en.bdb: Bathing in the holy dust of the lotus feet of the True Guru has great significance. Millions of places of pilgrimage reside in the refuge of the True Guru. One is deemed to have visited all the holy places by the touch of the dust of His holy feet.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਜ ਮਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ਅਤਿ ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵਕ ਹੁਇ ਪੂਜਤ ਚਰਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: charan kamal raj majan prataap at dhevee dhev sevak hui poojat charan hai ||

en.bdb: The glory and grandeur of the dust of True Guru's holy feet supreme. All gods and goddesses worship Him as His humble servants. (worship of all gods and goddesses lie in feet of the True Guru).

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਜ ਮਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ਅਤਿ ਕਾਰਨ ਅਧੀਨ ਕੀਨ ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: charan kamal raj majan prataap at kaaran adheen keen kaaran karan hai ||

en.bdb: The significance of bathing in the dust of the holy feet of True Guru is so great· that he who is ever under the causes, himself becomes the creator of those causes, by becoming a devoted slave of the True Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਜ ਮਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ਅਤਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਭਏ ਤਾਰਨ ਤਰਨ ਹੈ ॥੩੩੯॥
verses.translit_en: charan kamal raj majan prataap at patit puneet bhe taaran taran hai ||339||

en.bdb: Importance of touching of True Guru's holy feet is so supreme that a human being badly soiled in sins of maya becomes pious in his refuge. He even becomes a ship for others to sail across the worldly ocean. (339)
